prompt: What is the name of the father of the first cousin of the mother of the man whose name inspired the naming of the lunar mountain "Mons Hansteen"?
answer: The man was **Christopher Hansteen**, whose mother was **Anne Cathrine Treschow**. Her first cousin was the philosopher **Niels Treschow (1751–1833)**, whose father was **Niels Treschow**—the elder merchant of Drammen.
